newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - CSFB starts Glaxo as "hold".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CSFB starts Glaxo as "hold".

text.p: British drug group Glaxo Wellcome Plc was rated "hold" as CS First Boston started coverage of the stock, the investment bank said on Thursday.
In a research note, analyst Genghis Lloyd-Harris said Glaxo had an exciting pipeline of new high-growth products coupled with a clear strategic focus and vision.
However he said an upturn in the drug group's earnings growth and return on capital would be delayed until 1999. He advised investors to buy the stock on weakness.
Glaxo shares were down 10-1/2p at 13.02-1/2 by 1007 GMT in moderate trade of 2.4 million shares.
